verses.en: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
verses.pt: A palavra do Senhor a Israel, por intermédio de Malaquias.
verses.en_web: A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

verses.en: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
verses.pt: Eu vos tenho amado, diz o Senhor. Mas vós dizeis: Em que nos tens amado? Acaso não era Esaú irmão de Jacó? diz o Senhor; todavia amei a Jacó,
verses.en_web: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet I loved Jacob;
verses.en_bbe: You have been loved by me, says the Lord. But you say, Where was your love for us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? says the Lord: but Jacob was loved by me,

verses.en: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
verses.pt: e aborreci a Esaú; e fiz dos seus montes uma desolação, e dei a sua herança aos chacais do deserto.
verses.en_web: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
verses.en_bbe: And Esau was hated, and I sent destruction on his mountains, and gave his heritage to the beasts of the waste land.

verses.en: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.
verses.pt: Ainda que Edom diga: Arruinados estamos, porém tornaremos e edificaremos as ruínas; assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Eles edificarão, eu, porém, demolirei; e lhes chamarão: Termo de impiedade, e povo contra quem o Senhor está irado para sempre.
verses.en_web: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places”; Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”
verses.en_bbe: Though Edom says, We are crushed down but we will come back, building up the waste places; this is what the Lord of armies has said: They may put up buildings, but I will have them pulled down; and they will be named The land of evil-doing, and The people against whom the Lord keeps his wrath for ever.

verses.en: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
verses.pt: E os vossos olhos o verão, e direis: Engrandecido é o Senhor ainda além dos termos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
verses.en_bbe: And your eyes will see it; and you will say, The Lord is great even outside the limits of Israel.

verses.en: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
verses.pt: O filho honra o pai, e o servo ao seu amo; se eu, pois, sou pai, onde está a minha honra? e se eu sou amo, onde está o temor de mim? diz o Senhor dos exércitos a vós, ó sacerdotes, que desprezais o meu nome. E vós dizeis: Em que temos nós desprezado o teu nome?
verses.en_web: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me? Says Yahweh of Armies to you, priests, who despise my name. You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’
verses.en_bbe: A son gives honour to his father, and a servant has fear of his master: if then I am a father, where is my honour? and if I am a master, where is the fear of me? says the Lord of armies to you, O priests, who give no value to my name. And you say, How have we not given value to your name?

verses.en: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.
verses.pt: Ofereceis sobre o meu altar pão profano, e dizeis: Em que te havemos profanado? Nisto que pensais, que a mesa do Senhor é desprezível.
verses.en_web: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’
verses.en_bbe: You put unclean bread on my altar. And you say, How have we made it unclean? By your saying, The table of the Lord is of no value.

verses.en: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: Pois quando ofereceis em sacrifício um animal cego, isso não é mau? E quando ofereceis o coxo ou o doente, isso não é mau? Ora apresenta-o ao teu governador; terá ele agrado em ti? ou aceitará ele a tua pessoa? diz o Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And when you give what is blind for an offering, it is no evil! and when you give what is damaged and ill, it is no evil! Give it now to your ruler; will he be pleased with you, or will you have his approval? says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, suplicai o favor de Deus, para que se compadeça de nós. Com tal oferta da vossa mão, aceitará ele a vossa pessoa? diz o Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And now, make request for the grace of God so that he may have mercy on us: this has been your doing: will he give his approval to any of you? says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.pt: Oxalá que entre vós houvesse até um que fechasse as portas para que não acendesse debalde o fogo do meu altar. Eu não tenho prazer em vós, diz o Senhor dos exércitos, nem aceitarei oferta da vossa mão.
verses.en_web: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.en_bbe: If only there was one among you who would see that the doors were shut, so that you might not put a light to the fire on my altar for nothing! I have no pleasure in you, says the Lord of armies, and I will not take an offering from your hands.

verses.en: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: Mas desde o nascente do sol até o poente é grande entre as nações o meu nome; e em todo lugar se oferece ao meu nome incenso, e uma oblação pura; porque o meu nome é grande entre as nações, diz o Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: For from the rising of the sun even to the going down of the same, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering: for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: For, from the coming up of the sun till its going down, my name is great among the Gentiles; and in every place the smell of burning flesh is offered to my name, and a clean offering: for my name is great among the Gentiles, says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
verses.pt: Mas vós o profanais, quando dizeis: A mesa do Senhor é profana, e o seu produto, isto é, a sua comida, é desprezível.
verses.en_web: “But you profane it, in that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’
verses.en_bbe: But you make it unholy by saying, The Lord's table has become unclean, and his food is of no value.

verses.en: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Dizeis também: Eis aqui, que canseira! e o lançastes ao desprezo, diz o Senhor dos exércitos; e tendes trazido o que foi roubado, e o coxo e o doente; assim trazeis a oferta. Aceitaria eu isso de vossa mão? diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ and you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And you say, See, what a weariness it is! and you let out your breath at it, says the Lord of armies; and you have given what has been cut about by beasts, and what is damaged in its feet and ill; this is the offering you give: will this be pleasing to me from your hands? says the Lord.

verses.en: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
verses.pt: Mas seja maldito o enganador que, tendo animal macho no seu rebanho, o vota, e sacrifica ao Senhor o que tem mácula; porque eu sou grande Rei, diz o Senhor dos exércitos, e o meu nome é temível entre as nações.
verses.en_web: “But the deceiver is cursed, who has in his flock a male, and vows, and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
verses.en_bbe: A curse on the false man who has a male in his flock, and takes his oath, and gives to the Lord a damaged thing: for I am a great King, says the Lord of armies, and my name is to be feared among the Gentiles.
